g.text: How a match is collected — from the content pane to a painted Range
re-measure on the next frame and correct —
a content-visibility block only gets a real
height once it is scrolled into view
after it from its node offset.
normalize-query TRIMS, so a match can
never begin or end on a separator — and
can never contain "\n". A match may span
DOM shell — walk, Ranges, painting, scrolling
pure core — flatten, scan, locate (DOM-free, unit-tested)
a step that produces a token, a Range, or a highlight
style resolution / geometry (the memoized, costly part)
